answer: A haven that cannot be faked is earned one harbor call at a time: each identity must complete a chain of six verified port calls, and every call's ticket is stamped with the hash of the previous call's attested result plus the fresh epoch beacon, so a clone cannot copy or buy the chain. Each call costs 4 hours of attested work checked by two random peers, and a failed check voids the whole chain. A farm must sail all six calls for every puppet, in order, with no shortcut - the umber stamp of the last call is worthless without the five before it.
